parsed.explanation: No trans-specific presentation offence, border, facility or care rule is documented, so this is not an organised trans-targeting regime. But same-sex conduct is enforced with 1-2 year sentences in 2023, police extortion, a death in detention, and a presidential call to stone homosexuals described as licence to kill. No legal recognition, no protection from discrimination, no registered advocacy, and a broader record of arbitrary detention and torture leave an outed visitor with no recourse. Extrapolating the thin trans-specific record from these structural signals, consequences if outed are severe.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: 2023 mass arrest on same-sex charges, seven convicted and seven sentenced 1-2 years; one accused died in detention; 2009 police extortion for release documented.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: No effective recourse documented; advocacy intervened in 2009 case only.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Custody exposure follows any same-sex or gender-nonconformity investigation; trans-specific placement not documented.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Criminalisation of same-sex conduct 3 months-2 years, enforced 2023; president Dec 2023 called for stoning homosexuals and rejected aid conditioned on LGBT rights.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: No government protection from discrimination documented in 2016; no meaningful reform as of Mar 2026.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: State threat-framing increases police and social license against visibly gender-nonconforming visitors if identified under this law.

minors_guardians.exposure: 2016 case shows homosexuality charge added to rape-of-minor charge against a 15-year-old defendant; no traveller-family rule documented.
minors_guardians.interaction: A minor travelling with an adult faces the same enforced hostile law environment; no specific family protection documented.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Harassment, discrimination, family rejection and stigmatisation reported; LGBTQ residents reported terror after presidential remarks; broader crisis includes extrajudicial killings, arbitrary detention and torture.
street_violence_police_response.protection: No government protection documented; period reports list discrimination alongside security-force killings and torture.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Police are documented as enforcers/extortion actors, not protectors, for LGBT people.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No trans-specific violence, border, facility or care record; absence is not safety. No enforcement case documented after Aug 2023 sentences.
remedies_unknowns.protection: LGBTIQ organisations cannot register; rights league operates from exile, leaving no domestic complaint route documented.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Thin trans-specific data plus enforced criminalisation, hostile state framing and no recourse resolves toward risk, not midpoint.

anchor_checks.comparison: Higher than 0.15: no documented trans presentation offence, regular sweeps, birth-sex custody sexual assault pattern, or execution. Risk is severe but the documented targeting is(LGBT) criminalisation and state rhetoric, not a trans-specific capital/imprisonment campaign.

Higher than 0.25, but close: 0.25 requires documented police raids detaining gender-nonconforming people and custody abuse. Here police extortion and mass same-sex arrests are documented, but trans-specific raids/custody abuse are not, so it sits above organised trans targeting.

Similar to 0.35: recurring police extortion, detention, imprisonment for same-sex conduct, official hostility and no discipline or remedy. Difference is targeting is documented for gay people rather than trans visitors specifically, keeping it at the upper end of this tier.

Much lower than 0.65: that anchor has an unenforced dead-letter statute, documented acceptance and court compensation. Here the statute is enforced with prison sentences, state leaders call for stoning, and there is no protection or working remedy.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime: national enforced criminalisation operates without subnational variation, and hostile presidential framing licenses police and social action. Interaction is detention-to-imprisonment with documented extortion and a death in custody, and no trans-specific border, facility or care protections to interrupt it. Uncertainty on trans-specific practice cannot be credited as safety; the documented exposures and absence of any remedy place the visitor in high risk, below jurisdictions with only friction but above documented trans-specific sweeps.
